machine_identity_control_selection.selection_rule: First five Computers by SHA256([neo-seamless-identity-control-v1,node_id]), selected before identity search

interpretation: SEAMLESS raw has 100 empty Sessions arrays and no observed HasSession edge. This dataset cannot validate host/session identity acquisition.
Host admin-only scenario: 200 Computer pairs have no witness; 196 blocked, 4 at expansion cap. This does not prove the hosts safe or mean 200 Unknown queries.
Five User controls: 10/10 witnesses, all C-rated and natively replayed, C in {1,2,4,5}.
Five separately declared machine-account identities: 9/10 witnesses, all C-rated and natively replayed; one expansion cap. Local host control was not silently converted to machine identity.
Bulk runs were executed with the parent runner; the new runner only adds input diagnostics. Core engine source pins are identical. New CLI diagnostics were checked with one host and two goals.
Use SEAMLESS for directory/identity/C experiments and WRAITH for observed host/session experiments; neither establishes superiority over BloodHound.

reproduce.snapshot_note: Use a SEAMLESS snapshot with the recorded snapshot and graph identity, generated from the checked raw manifest. The original transport bytes and runner hashes are retained above.

validation.full_suite: not run; core engine unchanged from parent with 407 focused tests passing
